biotools.summary: AI-ZYMES is a comprehensive nanozyme database that utilizes artificial intelligence to accelerate research and application. The platform features standardized data curation, a dual AI framework for kinetic constant prediction and enzyme-mimicking activity identification, and a ChatGPT-based synthesis assistant.
